prompt:
You are improving a Next.js 16 + React 19 resume optimization application using Vercel AI SDK 5.x, Prisma, Zod, and custom hooks for AI state management. The codebase follows a layered architecture: app/ (Next.js App Router), components/ (React UI), and lib/ (business logic with services, repositories, and AI orchestration).
---
## OBJECTIVE
Re-enable AI streaming with resilient partial data handling, improve code quality and consistency, and enhance architecture with retry/fallback mechanisms.
---
## PHASE 1: ESLINT & ERROR CONSOLIDATION
### 1.1 Fix ESLint Configuration
File: eslint.config.mjs
Problem: Type-aware rules (@typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises, etc.) fail because __tests__/ files aren't in the TypeScript project.
Solution: Add parserOptions with projectService and tsconfigRootDir. Alternatively, update tsconfig.json to include "__tests__/**/*" in the include array.
### 1.2 Consolidate Error Classes
Files: lib/errors/*.ts
Actions:
- Remove duplicate RateLimitError from lib/errors/index.ts (keep in api.ts)
- Remove duplicate UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError from index.ts (keep in authentication.ts)
- Add optional "cause" parameter to ALL error constructors for error chaining
- Add new error codes to lib/types/error-codes.ts: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, REQUEST_TIMEOUT, CONFLICT
- Deprecate ServiceOperationError in lib/services/utils/service-wrapper/errors.ts with JSDoc @deprecated notice
---
## PHASE 2: BACKEND STREAMING
### 2.1 Orchestrator Streaming Methods
File: lib/ai/chat/orchestrator.ts
Add static async generator method "streamGenerate<T>" that:
- Uses streamObject from 'ai' package
- Yields { type: 'delta', partial: DeepPartial<T>, timestamp } for each partialObjectStream chunk
- Yields { type: 'complete', final: T, usage: TokenUsage } on completion
- Logs usage and stores output in ConversationManager same as non-streaming path
- Accepts abortSignal for cancellation
Add types to lib/ai/chat/orchestrator/types.ts:
- StreamChunkDelta<T> with type, partial, timestamp
- StreamChunkComplete<T> with type, final, usage
- StreamChunk<T> = StreamChunkDelta<T> | StreamChunkComplete<T>
- DeepPartial<T> utility type for recursive partial objects
### 2.2 API Route Streaming
File: app/api/v1/ai/chat/route.ts
- Add "stream: z.boolean().optional().default(false)" to chatRequestSchema
- When stream=true, create ReadableStream that iterates over AIOrchestrator.streamGenerate()
- Encode each chunk as SSE format: "data: ${JSON.stringify(chunk)}\n\n"
- Return Response with headers: Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive
- Handle errors by sending { type: 'error', error: message } before closing stream
---
## PHASE 3: FRONTEND STREAMING
### 3.1 Update useConversation Hook
File: components/ai-enhance/hooks/use-conversation/index.ts
- Add "stream?: boolean" to SendMessageOptions interface
- Add "isStreaming: boolean" to ConversationState interface
- In sendMessage, pass stream flag to API request body
- When response Content-Type is text/event-stream, use ReadableStreamDefaultReader to parse chunks
- Parse SSE lines (data: prefix), update state.output incrementally on delta chunks
- Set isStreaming=true during stream, false on complete
- Call onComplete only after receiving complete chunk
- Create helper function handleStreamResponse<T> to encapsulate stream parsing logic
### 3.2 Update useAITask Hook
File: components/ai-enhance/hooks/useAITask.ts
- Add "enableStreaming?: boolean" to AITaskOptions (default: true)
- Pass stream flag to sendMessage based on enableStreaming
- Expose isStreaming from state
- Expose partialOutput (state.output when isStreaming, null otherwise)
### 3.3 Type Utilities
File: lib/types/utils.ts (new)
Create DeepPartial<T> type that recursively makes all properties optional, handling arrays and nested objects. Add safeGet<T, K> helper function for accessing potentially undefined nested properties with defaults.
---
## PHASE 4: UI RESILIENCE
### 4.1 Update ResumePreview
File: components/resume/ResumePreview.tsx
- Change resumeData prop type to "Resume | DeepPartial<Resume>"
- Add optional "isStreaming?: boolean" prop
- Use useMemo to normalize partial data with safe defaults for all resume sections (basics, work, education, skills, projects, etc.)
- Add visual streaming indicator (pulse animation) when isStreaming=true
### 4.2 Update Template Renderer
File: lib/templates/renderers/server.ts
Register Handlebars helpers for safe data access:
- "safeEach": Check if array exists and has items before iterating, return inverse block if empty
- "safeIf": Check if value is defined and non-empty before rendering block
Update existing templates (lib/templates/assets/*/template.html) to use safeEach and safeIf helpers instead of standard each/if for resilient rendering during streaming.
---
## PHASE 5: WORKFLOW ENGINE ENHANCEMENTS
### 5.1 Add Retry Logic
File: lib/ai/workflow/engine.ts
Create RetryConfig interface with maxAttempts, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs, optional retryableErrors array.
Create executeStepWithRetry function that:
- Loops up to maxAttempts
- Catches errors and checks if retryable
- Calculates exponential backoff delay with jitter: min(baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1) + random(0-1000), maxDelayMs)
- Logs warning on each retry with attempt count and error message
- Throws last error if all attempts exhausted
Update executeWorkflow to use executeStepWithRetry with step.retry config or default config.
Add optional "retry?: RetryConfig" field to WorkflowStep interface in lib/ai/workflow/types.ts.
### 5.2 Validation-Correction Loop
File: lib/ai/core/validation-correction.ts (new)
Create generateWithValidation<T> function that:
- Takes config with model, schema, systemPrompt, maxCorrections (default: 2)
- Loops up to maxCorrections+1 attempts
- Calls generateObject with current messages
- On ZodError, extracts error paths/messages, appends correction prompt asking AI to fix specific issues
- Returns validated object on success
- Throws after exhausting correction attempts
- Logs warnings on each correction attempt
---
## PHASE 6: REPOSITORY OPTIMIZATION
### 6.1 Shallow Fetch Option
File: lib/repositories/profiles.repository.ts
- Create ProfileFindOptions interface with "includeDocument?: boolean" (default: true)
- Update findAllByUserId to accept options parameter
- When includeDocument=false, exclude document from Prisma include
- Update mapProfile to handle missing document, return undefined for resume field
Update dashboard and list view callers to pass { includeDocument: false } for performance.
---
## PHASE 7: COMPONENT CONSOLIDATION
### 7.1 Generic ResourceList Component
File: components/shared/ResourceList.tsx (new)
Create generic ResourceList<T extends { id: string }> component that:
- Accepts items, CardComponent, deleteAction, emptyState, gridCols props
- Uses useOptimistic for optimistic delete updates
- Handles loading, empty, and search-empty states
- Renders GalleryGrid with cards
Refactor ResumeListClient and CoverLetterListClient to use ResourceList.
### 7.2 Shared Types
File: components/ai-enhance/types.ts
- Export AttachmentInput interface with type, content, name, optional mimeType
- Export toApiAttachment helper function
- Update AIEnhanceResumeModal, AIEnhanceTextModal, AIEnhanceTemplateModal to import from this file instead of defining locally
---
## PHASE 8: TESTING
### Priority Test Files to Create:
1. lib/errors/__tests__/errors.test.ts
   - Test all error classes for correct statusCode, code, toJSON(), cause handling
2. lib/api/handler/__tests__/handler.test.ts
   - Test createApiHandler for auth, validation, error handling, rate limiting
3. lib/ai/workflow/__tests__/engine.test.ts
   - Test executeStepWithRetry retry logic, backoff timing, max attempts
4. components/ai-enhance/hooks/__tests__/useConversation.test.ts
   - Test streaming response handling with mock SSE
   - Test incremental state updates during stream
   - Test error handling during stream
---
## CODE STYLE REQUIREMENTS
Imports: External packages first, then type-only imports, then internal imports with @/ aliases.
Errors: Use AppError subclasses, never plain Error. Use type guards for error handling.
Logging: Use logger from @/lib/utils/logger with structured context. Never console.log.
Naming: Files in kebab-case, classes in PascalCase, functions/variables in camelCase, types in PascalCase.
Components: Use Readonly<Props> for prop types, useMemo for derived state, useCallback for handlers passed to children.
---
## IMPLEMENTATION ORDER
1. ESLint fix and error consolidation (foundation)
2. Backend streaming (orchestrator + API route)
3. Frontend streaming (hooks + types)
4. UI resilience (components + templates)
5. Workflow enhancements (retry + validation-correction)
6. Repository optimization (shallow fetch)
7. Component consolidation (ResourceList + shared types)
8. Add priority tests
Start with Phase 1, then proceed sequentially. Run linting after Phase 1 to verify fix. Test streaming end-to-end after completing Phases 2-4 before proceeding.
